name: TrussCraft
intro: Timber roof trusses from a roof in the model: common trusses, hip sets (step-down trusses, or a girder carrying jack and corner trusses), valley sets over a main roof, the member, cut and joint lists, loads and combinations you enter, and a first member check. A design aid, not a design.
heel: Heel height at the outer face (mm)
load.roofDead: Roof dead load on the slope (kPa)
load.snow: Snow or roof live on plan (kPa)
roof.none: No roof in the model: use the outline below
outline: Outline (x, y in mm, one corner per line)
result.design: {type} truss: top chord {top}, bottom chord {bottom}, webs {web}; {n} members; the most stressed is at {max} of its capacity.
result.nosolve: {type} truss: the forces cannot be found by the method of joints ({status}). See Problems.
result.layout: {n} trusses at about {sp} mm; spans {spans} mm.
label.notdesign: Not a substitute for engineered truss design or manufacturer sign-off.
dwg.title: Truss elevation: {type}
dwg.sizes: Top chord {top} · bottom chord {bottom} · webs {web} · indicative, joints numbered, forces in kN (+ tension)
err.span: The span must be between 1.5 and 30 m.
err.pitch: The pitch must be between 5 and 60 degrees.
err.scissor: The bottom chord pitch must be well under the top chord pitch for a scissor truss.
err.attic: The room width must be at least 1.5 m and leave 0.3 m each side inside the span.
err.atticHeight: The room height must be at least 1.8 m and under the roof where the knee walls meet it.
err.outline: The roof outline needs at least three corners and some area.
err.spacing: The spacing must be between 200 and 3000 mm.
err.noroof: Choose a roof from the model to place them on.
err.write: This version of BimCraft cannot write into the model for add-ons (needs add-on API 1.1).
cmd.layout: Trusses: lay out on the roof
result.set: Set: {kinds}; {designs} distinct designs, {members} pieces in the cut list.
combo.name: Combination
species.load: Load my species table (CSV or JSON)
species.reset: Back to the labelled typical values.
combos: Combinations: factors times each case. Blank or zero is off.
plates.load: Load my plate table (CSV or JSON)
hip.girder: Girder carrying jack and corner trusses
setback: Girder setback from the end wall (mm, 0 = half the hip)
valley.set: Valley set over the main roof
err.profile: The roof section there could not be read as a truss.
err.low: The truss would be lower than 120 mm.
err.roofplan: BimCraft could not make a roof from this outline (check the corners and the pitch).
err.valleyparams: A valley set needs the wing width and both pitches (5 to 60 degrees).
err.valleyempty: No valley truss is tall enough at that spacing.
err.valleyskew: The valley is not square to the ridge.
export.jig: Jig layout of one truss, life size (SVG)
fab.jig.title: Jig layout: {type} truss
fab.jig.scale: Drawn 1:1: print at 100 % (no fit to page). Plate rectangles are the placeholder or your table's sizes.
fab.jig.cuts: Cuts (long point to long point, end angles from square)
result.cleared: The placed trusses are removed (one undo step).
result.nothing: There is nothing of TrussCraft's to remove.
pick.done: Outline taken from the selection: {n} corners.
stockLengths: Stock lengths to cut from, mm (comma-separated; blank = the stock length above)
cad.forces.title: Member forces: {type} truss (kN)
cad.forces.key: Tension on layer TRUSS-TENSION, compression on TRUSS-COMPRESSION (+ tension, - compression)
cad.layout.title: Roof truss layout: {n} trusses
